title: Gas Density / Temperature Relations
theory: $\rho = \dfrac{m}{V} = \dfrac{PM_{mol}}{RT}$: at fixed pressure $\rho \propto 1/T$ (hot air is thin); at fixed temperature $\rho \propto P$. **Host example:** 2014-Q1-(3) (Topic 14) — a density quoted at one temperature fixes the contained mass at every other temperature through $mT = \text{const}$.
